decision_log.decision: Machine-readable PRD JSON is canonical; no new Markdown PRD is introduced.
OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops are the deployment/ops path; manual SSH troubleshooting is explicitly out of scope.
HR, Payroll, and Accounting are the first children; platform model remains extensible for procurement, compliance, assets, and corporate intelligence.

ADR-0131/ADR-0132 flat microservice layout supersedes earlier tenant-rbac crate naming; Accounting implementation crates use oya-accounting-<bounded-context>-<layer> under microservices/accounting/crates/.

Accounting app-layer crate emits metadata-only audit and Workflow dispatch envelopes over the pure journal domain; ledger persistence, tax filing, payment execution, Workflow calls, and cloud adapters remain out of scope.

Accounting API crate owns serializable DTO contracts and deterministic conversion into journal domain inputs; deployed HTTP routing, auth middleware, ledger persistence, tax filing, and runtime adapters remain out of scope.

Accounting OpenAPI v1 preview contract aligns to accounting API DTO crate shapes for journal posting, payroll posting, and VAT workflow planning; deployed HTTP runtime, ledger persistence, and tax filing remain out of scope.

Accounting Jenkins LTS quality gate covers the journal domain/app/API package group plus the accounting OpenAPI contract; ArgoCD, Helm, runtime deploy, ledger persistence, tax filing transport, payment execution, and cloud adapters remain out of scope until deployable adapters land.

Accounting runtime adapter crate binds accounting API DTOs to the repo-native Hyper router/middleware foundation and returns OpenAPI-aligned JSON responses; it is router-ready but does not deploy a listener, persist ledgers, execute Workflow, submit statutory filings, execute payments, call Payroll, or emit runtime audit-chain events.

Accounting in-memory storage adapter crate records metadata-only app envelopes for journal posting, payroll posting, and VAT Workflow dispatch as a volatile reference seam; durable ledger backend, Postgres/RLS, Workflow execution, filing rails, payment execution, Payroll network calls, and audit-chain emission remain out of scope.

Accounting statutory tax rulepacks are represented first as source-versioned manifest provenance in the accounting journal domain; this prepares later durable ledger, Workflow, statutory filing, and cloud adapters without claiming ledger persistence, Workflow execution, filing transport, payment execution, production statutory correctness, or runtime audit-chain emission.
